message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts: Liu X directed others to cut down trees (杨树) on land without permit. This is illegal logging. In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "非法采伐林木罪" (illegal logging) or "非法采伐林木罪" (illegal logging of forest trees). Also possibly "破坏森林资源罪". The official label used in earlier examples: they used "放火", "故意伤害", "诈骗", "非法持有毒品", "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". For illegal logging, typical charge: "非法采伐林木罪". Also could be "破坏森林资源罪". Which is correct? Chinese Criminal Law Article 322: "非法采伐林木罪" (illegal logging). Also Article 338: "破坏森林资源罪" includes illegal logging, damaging forest. Usually illegal logging is under "非法采伐林木罪". So answer: [罪名]非法采伐林木罪<eoa>. Provide JSON with reasoning and final answer.
